title: A Novel Idea
description: Chang the Ninth has made up his mind to write a new novel again, but he doesn't know where to start. He desperately needs to find inspiration...

mainQuestExcel.description: Chang the Ninth has made up his mind to write a new novel again, but he doesn't know where to start. He desperately needs to find inspiration...

dialogs.text: I just don't know where to start...
What are you up to now?
Oh, it's you again. I'm writing a new novel — well, trying to. I just can't seem to find a compelling idea for an intro.
I've been racking my brains for ages, but I'm at a complete loss. At this rate, who knows when I'll be able to start writing in earnest...
You're a traveler, yes? You know what the world is like. So tell me, what do you think the key ingredient is to a successful novel?
Heart and soul.
Oh, come on. Don't give me that nonsense! I'm asking a serious question here!
Epic battles.
Battles, eh... Battles... There's something to that idea. It's attention-grabbing, at least.
Though I can hardly find inspiration on that topic in Qingce Village... No battles here, let alone the epic variety...
I'd need to look further afield... In the wild! Yes, that'd do it! I hear there are many adventurers out in the wild.
They go roaming all over the place looking for treasure, and always end up in battle with monsters.

As it happens, I know a place where there are plenty of monsters. Not your average monsters either, these ones are quite something! Yes! We can go there and wait for an adventurer to show up, and then witness the ensuing battle firsthand.
And then... Haha, then I'd have everything I need! Right then! Without further ado, I shall be off! There's quite some distance to cover, so don't be too long yourselves, either!

flow.stepDescription: Listen in on Sisi and Chaoxi's conversation

dialogs.text: Chaoxi, you're back! I just found out how to cook this amazing new dish. Why not come back with me? I'll cook it for you!
Sisi, I literally just got back and I'm completely drained, mentally and physically. I just need to lie down right now...
Yes, of course — all that hard work, you must be exhausted. Definitely get some rest.
So... Let's have a proper catch-up after you've fully recovered, shall we? We could always set a date now...
Sure, sounds great. I'll let you know. I just can't commit to a specific date right now... I'm not trying to get out of it, I just don't want to make a promise I can't keep...
*sigh* I'm a sailor, Sisi. And as a sailor, I'm married to the sea. You deserve much better...
Don't talk like that, Chaoxi... You know I understand...
Romantic thoughts, Chang, romantic thoughts... Hmm, this is really not my forte...

dialogs.text: Lulu, it's definitely Fei's turn to be the captain this time.
Right! I keep saying, why do I have to be the first mate all the time?
I just think it's more fun for everyone involved when Meng is the captain.
That's a bit unfair, Lulu. I think Fei plays it very well.
Everyone plays their parts very well. You as the captain, me as the rich merchant, and Fei as first mate.
And this time is gonna be the funnest of all! What do you think, Fei?
Lulu, come on...
Well... If that's what you think, Lulu... I—I guess it's okay by me.
Fei...! We've talked about this...
No, it's fine. I don't mind. Whatever makes Lulu happy. Come on, let's play.

Mm, yes... I think I have the beginnings of a plot...

Well, yes, that was the original idea. But then the adventurers I was counting on didn't show up...
I noticed the monsters were slowly starting to make a move. If they'd all left, this would have been a wasted trip.
So... I threw a stone at them. That's how the stories always go, isn't it? Throw a stone, get their attention. Or something.
How was I to know the stone would hit one of them square on the head? And then... Well, you know the rest.
Anyway, all's well that ends well. Sure, I got some scrapes and bruises... but boy, did I get a story too. And that's what I came for.
Finally, I can feel the creative juices starting to flow! Oh — by the way, take this for your trouble. Thanks.
Methinks my writer's block has been dealt a fatal blow! I must away, my pen and paper eagerly await my return...
A gushy romance.
Last time I went into the city, I saw a man talking to a young lady who appeared to be a fortune-teller. He was prattling away... I didn't bother to listen in.

I later found out the garrulous gent's name is Zhihua, and the fortune-telling lady's is Qiming. Seems there's some history there... Why don't you go ask them about their stories? If it's anything interesting, come back and fill me in.
Now I think about it... do you know a Sisi, by any chance? She often hangs around the harbor, waiting for some sailor named Chaoxi.
She seems to go out and look for him on quite a regular basis. There must be a backstory there, surely?
Do a little investigating, anyway. If you come across any good stories, note them down and bring them back here.
Ah yes, there's three children who are always playing down by the harbor. Meng, Lulu, Fei. Ring any bells?
I know they're only children, but... between the three of them, they must have some tales to tell, surely.
Go and look into it, anyway. Make a note of any good material, and bring it back here.
Romance... I'd have my work cut out, that's for sure. My knowledge of romance is... let's say, broad strokes at the most...
But you have a point — there are plenty of people like me in the world who are completely lacking in experience or understanding of romance. The market is ripe for the taking.
But how would I research for a romantic story? Let me see...
